from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u006/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                x, y = q.popleft()
                cells.append((x, y))
                for dx, dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    a, b = x+dx, y+dy
                    if 0 <= a < h and 0 <= b < w and grid[a][b] == 0 and (a,b) not in seen:
                        seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
            top = any(x == 0 for x, _ in cells)
            bottom = any(x == h-1 for x, _ in cells)
            left = any(y == 0 for _, y in cells)
            right = any(y == w-1 for _, y in cells)
            color = None
            if len(cells) >= 10 and (top or bottom or right):
                color = 8
            elif len(cells) <= 4 and (top or bottom) and (not left or bottom):
                color = 7
            if color is not None:
                for x, y in cells:
                    out[x][y] = color
    return out
'''
